resnet_specification.name: resnet-memory
resnet_specification.goal: Minimize the source's peak_allocated_bytes for the offline batch-32 workload while retaining images_per_second >= 0.95 of the original baseline, preserving its pretrained model, real image inputs, FP32 numerical policies, full logits and exact predicted classes. Keep the original workload and completion boundary.

intake_note_not_in_production: Separate required task semantics from the source's implementation choices. The baseline evaluator must reproduce the original implementation, but a choice is not a frozen requirement merely because it appears in the source. In description fields (including notes and invocation), preserve user/source-required workload, numerical behavior, outputs and completion boundaries; cite the requirement that makes a restriction necessary. Record incidental implementation choices as baseline behavior in assumptions, without prohibiting semantics-preserving alternatives or proposing an optimization.
tp_protocol: Original Qwen interactive B1/S256/N32 loop, BF16/SDPA, exact tokens and original full logits tolerance; 2 quality invocations, 2 warmups, 5 samples, one separate full-workload profile per rank; single GPU then official TP=2. Quality failures retained, not optimized.
scope: No production prompt mutation, no score-dependent extra runs, no model/API budget. Frozen old experiments untouched. New snapshot archives source/scripts/examples only to avoid duplicating historical evidence.
